nodes.label: Single-page app bootstrap via ES module entry
nodes.rationale: The HTML body carries no markup other than an empty #root div and a type=module script pointing at /src/main.jsx. This is the Vite/React SPA convention: the browser loads a near-empty document, the bundler-served ES module takes over and renders the whole UI client-side. Trade-off accepted: no server-rendered content (weaker first paint and SEO) in exchange for a single client-owned render tree and native ESM dev serving with no build step during development.
nodes.norm_label: single-page app bootstrap via es module entry

nodes.label: Google Fonts typography stack (Bricolage Grotesque + Hanken Grotesk)
nodes.rationale: Two remote font families are loaded from fonts.googleapis.com with preconnect hints to both googleapis and gstatic, and display=swap. Bricolage Grotesque is pulled as a variable optical-size display face at weights 500-800 (headings/brand), Hanken Grotesk at 400-700 as the reading face. The preconnect pair and swap are deliberate first-paint mitigations for the extra third-party round trip.
nodes.norm_label: google fonts typography stack (bricolage grotesque + hanken grotesk)

nodes.label: Inline data-URI SVG favicon (play glyph)
nodes.rationale: The favicon is embedded as a data:image/svg+xml URI rather than a file asset: a rounded dark-purple square (#221A38) with an orange (#F15B41) play triangle. Avoids an extra network request and keeps the brand colors declared inline in the shell, at the cost of an unminified escaped-markup attribute. The play glyph signals a video/creator-media product, matching the 'Creator Dashboard' title.
